title: Iran tests a bomb, and Israel answers

strikes.target_name: Simulated mountain test site, central Iran (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Minute zero, the first nuclear event. 1 kt, the top of the small first-test range of North Korea 2006 (A23: under 1 kt by US DNI, 0.48 to 2 kt in other estimates). Deep contained test: the engine only knows air or ground, so ground is a label here and the engine's surface rings and fallout are NOT shown for the test; the script says it was contained and that this is an assumption. The site is invented; it is a Fordow-type mountain (A9), not Fordow or Pickaxe (A12).

strikes.weapon: Israeli F-15I with GBU-28 and BLU-109 bunker busters
strikes.notes: Hour 40, same raid. Isfahan stored enriched uranium in tunnels too deep for the MOP in 2025 (A13, A14). Approximate coordinates.

strikes.target_name: Simulated mountain test site, tunnel entrances
strikes.weapon: Israeli F-15I with GBU-28 and BLU-109 bunker busters
strikes.notes: Hour 40 after the test. Israel has the GBU-28 and BLU-109 but not the GBU-57, so it can hit entrances, not deep halls (A10, A13: Isfahan 2025 entrances). Echoes the NPEC game where conventional strikes failed to stop warhead work (A24).

strikes.launch_name: Iranian missile brigade, western Iran (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hour 42, fired as the raids land (after Isfahan 2505.7 and test site 2512.3 min), retaliation, in the pattern of June 2025 (A21: about 550 missiles, about 90 percent intercepted). One missile stands for a salvo.

strikes.launch_name: Israeli Jericho II battery, central Israel (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Simulated mountain test site, central Iran (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 4, HERO. Worst case drawn from the NPEC 2024 game, where Israel used nuclear weapons after conventional strikes failed (A24). Israel never confirms its arsenal (A18); Jericho II range 1,500 km or more (A19). 10 kt is a simulation choice, not a known Israeli yield. Ground burst, the only way a nuclear weapon addresses a buried target. Burst is one weapon, one site, in a thinly populated area (a choice).

model: Glasstone and Dolan scaling calibrated to NUKEMAP Hiroshima figures; flight times fitted to published ranges; all values are estimates for a labelled simulation.
